prerequisites: Fractions and reciprocals with explicit units.
explanation: For the same work, time and constant rate are inversely proportional. A combined rate must be separated before recovering a solo duration.

worked.action: For equal work, time is work divided by rate.
worked.justification: A higher constant rate needs less time for the same work.

worked.action: If A:B rates are 3:2 and A takes 10 days, total work can be 30 units.
B does 2 units/day and takes 30/2 =15 days.
worked.justification: The time ratio is 2:3, inverse to the rate ratio 3:2.

worked.action: If rates are A:B=2:3 and together they finish in 6 days, total work is 5 times 6 =30 units; A alone needs 15 days.
worked.justification: Combined time must first be converted to work on the chosen rate scale.
